property.name: key_name
property.value: Standing Order of Miravel

property.name: text
property.value:
By the King's oath, sworn on the blade: no quarter, no prisoners, no retreat.

Any man who turns from the field will be drowned in the marsh beside the ones who turned before him.

The King is with you. The King is always with you.

property.name: key_name
property.value: An Unsent Letter

property.name: text
property.value:
Mira -

They say there are six hundred thousand of us on the field, both armies counted. From the ridge I cannot see the end of it.

The Miravel men do not sing any more. Their king carries a red sword now, and they say it is thirsty.

If we lose tomorrow, burn this, so they never learn your name.

- T.

property.name: title
property.value: An Unsent Letter

property.name: key_got
property.value: Crimson Oath. It drinks what it cuts, and it answers hardest when there is little left of you.

property.name: text
property.value:
He drank the most, and he drowned the first.

A boy from a poor village in the east swore this blade to a broken kingdom, and made it whole. Then the field of six hundred thousand woke something, and the blade drank the rest of the war for him.

The Ascended's light burned it out of him. He walked into these marshes and did not walk out. No one ever found the body; no one was meant to. His hands are still folded over the hilt.
